compute_budget_policy: Each numeric budget is gpu_s per arm per complete fixed-work timing trial. Budgets are resource ceilings, not changed step counts or simulated-time targets. Same fixed eight-replica outputs at each budget; incomplete runs fail. No calibrated scientific outcome-versus-compute curve exists. With no feasible methods, there are no outcome forecast points. Budgets are prospective choices, not measured costs.

confidence_rule.decision: Use exact binomial order-statistic bounds, without normal approximations. Performance: one-sided 95% lower bound on median paired baseline/method GPU-second ratio must exceed 1.05. Equivalence: alpha=1-0.95=0.05, Bonferroni across two energy metrics, two-sided per-metric confidence 0.975. For eight seeds the finite interval is [minimum paired difference, maximum paired difference], with actual coverage 1-2*(0.5^8)=0.9921875. Require each entire interval strictly within [-abs_margin,+abs_margin]. Require every fixed-work replica, seed, step count and summary present. Lack of significance is not equivalence. Missing outputs, budget exhaustion or nonfinite bounds fail; no post hoc exclusions. No method is eligible in this seal.

equal_outcome_target.reason: Fixed-work benchmark: eight replicas each complete 25000 steps, totaling 0.8 ns. No calibrated outcome curve or scalar success threshold exists. Scientific acceptance requires both paired energy equivalence tests plus fixed-work completeness.

evaluation_inputs.generated_inputs: For replica i=0..7 use seed 1000+i in both setVelocitiesToTemperature(300 K, seed) and integrator.setRandomNumberSeed(seed); restart from pinned coordinates each arm. No adaptive input or scale selection.

evidence_limits: Negative result: every supplied deterministic bound is below minimum worthwhile gain; no method gain measured or predicted.
Profile kernel fraction 0.6032018734041273 and CUDA API host fraction 0.39264857405356496 do not establish concurrent headroom; concurrency and mean GPU utilization are unavailable.
Baseline energy series are not persisted; temporal autocorrelation and same-seed run-to-run variation cannot be estimated. Energy margins use across-seed summary variability only.

results/reproduce/anchors_scored.json reports contextual throughput 1.1786524231480573 microseconds/day versus approximate published 5.0 with no tolerance; zero acceptance anchors. This provides no energy tolerance or method gain.
No named gate script was provided; no scripts, builds or workloads executed. Scope, margins, seeds, budgets and decision rules require a new seal if changed.

Cost = allocated GPU count times timed wall seconds, including host and idle time. All eligible comparisons would use equal GPU-second budgets.

paired_seed_tests.description: Pair baseline and candidate by input and replica seed. Both initial velocities and Langevin integrator use that seed. Compute candidate minus baseline energy for each seed and metric. Stochastic classification applies despite fixed seeds and DeterministicForces=true. Timing repeats are not independent scientific seeds.

power.assumptions: Prospective conditional design: independent seed pairs, with probability at least 0.99 that both paired energy differences fall strictly inside their respective margins for each seed. Then probability that all eight pairs satisfy both margins is at least 0.99^8 = 0.9227446944279201, sufficient for both exact order-statistic intervals to pass. Baseline has no candidate paired-difference distribution; this assumption is unverified, not measured power. No unconditional power claim is supported. Failure cannot trigger extra seeds or changed margins.

scheduling_protocol: Within each budget, run 20 adjacent baseline/method timing pairs; seeded pseudorandom fair coin chooses AB or BA independently per pair. Single GPU runs one arm at a time with no unrelated workload. Reinitialize arms identically. Keep all timing pairs. Scientific equivalence uses one predesignated pair (pair 1) per budget; repeated same seeds do not enlarge scientific sample size. Require all budget-specific decisions to pass; no selection of favorable budget.

splits.calibration: Existing baseline seeds 1000..1007 supply variability margins only; no method outputs exist.
splits.evaluation: Same fixed input and eight paired seeds, predeclared before method code. No held-out inputs or seeds; this is a fixed-work replication, not a generalization claim. No training or tuning split.

timing_scope.description: Whole fixed eight-replica ensemble timer matching intake/brief.md: after PDB loading, system construction and platform lookup; before first context creation through destruction of last context and complete summary aggregation. Include context JIT, initialization, all 200000 aggregate steps, 100 energy queries per replica, transfers, method worker launch, any per-run MPS setup, synchronization and result merge inside corresponding method timer. Adapter synchronizes GPU at both boundaries. Exclude package installation, common PDB/system setup, final JSON serialization and stdout. Existing baseline total_wall_s=58.64324260700005; profile total_wall_s=62.679320044000065 is separate evidence, not a substitute timing pair.

warmup_protocol: One complete untimed fixed-work ensemble per arm on the same GPU before timing, with identical seeds/configuration. Retain resulting kernel cache equally for both arms. Each timed arm creates fresh contexts and resets coordinates and random seeds. Do not reuse scientific states from warmup.
